label: Сила
description: A 10-sentence usage card for сила (force; strength).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Сила' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'удивляет'. 'Его' marks possession, and 'меня' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Силу' is the accusative direct object of 'чувствую'. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. After 'нет', the noun becomes genitive 'силы'. The infinitive 'спорить' explains what there is no strength for.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'благодаря'. 'Силе' is the dative following 'благодаря', expressing the cause. 'Воли' is genitive, linking will to strength.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Силой' is the instrumental object that 'управляет' governs, expressing what is controlled. 'Ветра' is genitive of relation.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О силе' uses the prepositional after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Духа' is genitive, forming the idiom strength of spirit.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural idiom. 'Сил' is the genitive plural in the fixed phrase 'изо всех сил', meaning with all one's might. A high-frequency expression.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Силы' is the nominative plural subject. 'Огромные' agrees in the plural, and 'у природы' uses the genitive to show possession.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural with 'в'. 'Силы' is the accusative plural after 'в' meaning belief in one's abilities. 'Свои' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative evaluation. 'Сила' is nominative as the subject. 'Эта' agrees in the feminine, and 'велика' is the short feminine adjective intensified by 'невероятно'.
